author: I-XÆh
transcript: If you treat your social media like shadow work, you will be rewarded for it. It's exposure therapy, and it puts some of the most vulnerable parts of yourself on display on a global stage for the whole fucking world to see. Yes, it is destabilizing, it is scary, it is- it can be destructive, but things need to be destroyed. Certain stories that you tell yourself need to be disrupted. That's why social media, in my opinion, that's why I love to post. I treated it like a fucking experiment. I treated the algorithm like a feedback system, not an enemy. And you know what? It taught me so many things about myself, about the way people will receive me if I just honor my playful energy and I just fucking get in the mode. Try it.
title: Treat Social Media as Shadow Work
one_liner: Posting on social media as exposure therapy reveals and disrupts limiting self-stories.
key_points: Treat social media like shadow work — putting vulnerable parts of yourself on a global stage
View the algorithm as a feedback system, not an enemy
Disruption and discomfort are necessary to break down false self-narratives
Honoring your authentic, playful energy earns genuine audience connection
